name: 63-hidebehind
description: Hidebehind: a shaggy dark-brown furry creature, tall cone-shaped body like a hunched shadow, two long thin arms raised high with fans of long ivory claws. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Lurking idle in place, facing the viewer: the shaggy body sways and at the midpoint dips down slightly, arms and claws always raised high in the same place, then rises back. Same size, black one-pixel outlines and flat fills. No walking or effects.
